note: Patterns that read as « AI slop » in the narration, the titles and the descriptions of Onigam Labs (owner, 2026-11-11). Derived from the real texts of the gasifier, house, Pelton and ram pump labs and of the six films. Regexes are matched on the SPOKEN text (the [[cues]] removed, spaces made one) with the flags g, i, u. `hold` is a ceiling in hits per 1,000 characters for a lab guide (about 24,000 characters), `holdFilm` the one for a film script, a Short or a description (3,000 to 7,000 characters); a script is allowed at least one hit of a pattern whose ceiling is not zero (allowed = max(1, round(ceiling x characters / 1000))). `perSegment` is the most hits one segment may carry (0: none at all; 99: not tested). `apos` stands for the two apostrophes: the scripts use the typographic one, the YouTube texts the straight one. A regex cannot judge meaning: see STYLE.md, « What a regex cannot catch ».

patterns.label: Stock opener or « let's follow »
Walk-through signpost (« voyons », « let's see », « take »)
Short rhetorical question (a question sentence of 38 characters or fewer, or a question opened by et/mais/and/but/alors/so)
« Not X, it is Y » turn
patterns.fr: \bn['’]est pas [^.;:!?]{1,50}[;:,]\s*(?:c['’]est|il est|elle est|ce sont)\b|\bne [^.;:!?]{1,30}\bpas [^.;:!?]{1,50}\bmais\b|,\s+(?:et )?pas (?:un|une|le|la|les|l['’]|du|des|de|d['’]|que)\b|\bpas (?:un|une|le|la|les)\s\S+\s*:\s*(?:un|une|le|la|les)\b|\bn['’]est pas (?:une?|le|la|les) [^.;:!?]{1,30}[.;:]\s*(?:C['’]est|Ce sont)\b|\bSans [^.!?,]{2,20}, (?:plus|pas) d[e’']

patterns.label: Exclamation mark
Exclamation used as a beat (sentence of 28 characters or fewer ending in !)
Sentence made only of three parallel short items (a, b and c), each opened by an article or a number
Three consecutive sentences opened by the same word
Wonder and expert-voice vocabulary (astuce, elegant, the trick, the heart of, the strangest, the real hero)
patterns.fr: \b(?:astuce|astucieu(?:x|se)|élégant(?:e|es)?|ingénieu(?:x|se)|fascinant(?:e|s)?|incroyable|extraordinaire|remarquable|magnifique|magique|tour de magie|miracle|merveille|le vrai héros|le secret|la clé|tout se joue|change tout|le cœur de (?:la machine|l['’]affaire|l['’]histoire|toute)|le plus (?:étrange|curieux|grave|surprenant|beau)|la plus (?:élégante|grave|belle)|bon sens)\b
patterns.en: \b(?:the trick|clever|ingenious|elegant|fascinating|incredible|extraordinary|remarkable|magnificent|magic(?:al)?|conjuring|miracle|marvel|the real hero|the secret|the key|where everything|changes everything|the heart of|the (?:strangest|oddest|gravest|most (?:elegant|surprising|curious))|common sense)\b

patterns.label: Suspense ellipsis inside a sentence (… followed by a word)
Stock turn (et pourtant, and yet, and that is not all, mais voilà)
patterns.fr: \bet pourtant\b|(?:^|[.!?…]\s+)Pourtant\b|\b(?:et )?ce n['’]est pas tout\b|\bmais voilà\b|\bet voilà\b|\bmais ce n['’]est pas fini\b
patterns.en: \band yet\b|(?:^|[.!?…]\s+)Yet\b|\band that['’]s not all\b|\bbut wait\b|\bhere['’]s the thing\b

patterns.label: Presentational announcement (voici, voilà, here is, this is the…)
Talking to the screen (voyez, regardez, watch, look, see)
Closing invitation formula (go on, X is waiting)
patterns.en: \bGo on,\s[^.!?]{1,45}[.!]|\bTake your time\b|\bover to you\b|\bit['’]s your turn\b

patterns.label: The lab speaks of itself as an actor (« ce lab ne choisit pas », « the lab keeps both »)
Question answered at once by a fragment (The price? Fourteen per cent.)
Colon density (« X : Y » reveal in nearly every part)
All question marks (a question must earn its place)
Sentence opened by « Ni X, ni Y » / « Neither X nor Y » (a negative cadence used as scene-setting)

extra: Same sentence twice in one script (refrain): count it with a script, not a regex.
Titles and Short hooks: every title is a question or a plain statement of fact; none holds a colon-reveal, an « and the answer will surprise you » promise, or a second question.
calibration: hold = Pelton Lab's own measured level where Pelton is clean on the pattern; below it where Pelton is the tic (exclamations 0.8, ellipsis, wonder words, « et pourtant »); zero where the pattern carries no information (stock opener, invitation formula).
